name: Primal Step
description: Cross any stretch of ground by returning it to the first undivided extent and stepping through.

name: Primal Guard
description: Hold the oldest space before the body so that a blow finds nowhere to land.

name: Primal Sense
description: Read the shape of all space across a wide region at once and mark each body within it.

name: Primal Poise
description: Rest the user in the first extent where every technique runs clean and no distance blunts it.

name: Origin Lance
description: Cast a lance down the first line of space so it pierces whatever lies along it.

name: Origin Veil
description: Spread the first space over the user and nearby allies so lesser strikes fade and every move gains ease.

name: Origin Shift
description: Shift the whole body back into the first extent and out again at any chosen point.

name: Origin Pull
description: Draw a foe or a whole rank back into the first extent where they cannot act.

name: World Fold
description: Fold the world about the foes into a single closed place with a weight set by the core's reserve.

name: Pinned World
description: Pin the space of a region fast so that nothing within it may leave or enter at the user's word.

name: Spatial Oblivion
description: Unmake the space of a whole vale so all within it vanishes up to the ceiling of a Core-tier master.

name: Unmade Distance
description: Remove the distance between any two points of the world so they are one place; no cultivation mechanic explains how.
